snippet.title: Tetris 2 (Tetris Flash) Japanese store promo video
snippet.description: I gathered a bunch of promo VHS's from some Japanese auction site, and since a Nintendo direct is coming up, I thought it'd be the perfect time to upload them. Check out the channel for a few others.
